scope: Direct visual inspection of renders made from all three actual release PDFs, not their separately exported PNGs

inspection.layout: Five model rows, two columns (training Dice+CE and validation IoU); all labels and epoch ticks readable.
inspection.coverage: Four labeled fit trajectories per model: three primary seeds at LR0.003 plus dashed seed42 auxiliary LR0.001, representing all20fits in both columns. Curves naturally overlap at some epochs.

inspection.layout: Six panels: validation and descriptive test rows, pooled/Optical/SAR columns.
inspection.coverage: All five control labels and three colored seed trajectories are visible in every panel; bottom seed legend is clear and separate from tick labels.

inspection.layout: Validation and descriptive test panels, each with frozen quantum, zero bottleneck, compact affine and MLP comparison groups.
inspection.coverage: All three offset seed points, black mean/error bars, zero reference lines and quantum-minus-control IoU-point axis labels are visible. Seed legend is separate from x-axis labels.
findings: README states paired differences and mean±sampleSD generally, but does not explicitly say black bars depict mean±sampleSD. This is a caption-clarity observation, not a rendering defect.

caption_observations: README defines mean±sampleSD and paired units; the explicit visual mapping of black bars to mean±sampleSD is not stated.
review_scope: Artifact QA only; not the formal Astra results review or a new scientific experiment
